description: Final cleanup: update scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js to remove all RQ references and methodology_notes from the data pipeline, ensure the build is clean, and remove any remaining dark theme artifacts across the codebase.

Keep species data, habitat, conservation, cultural_significance, threats, root_causes_comb, evidence_summary, academic_references, and hero_stat fields. STEP 3 - Run npm run build one final time to confirm the full project builds cleanly.
STEP 4 - Verify that dist/ output contains all expected pages: index.html and all 10 species HTML pages.
